text:
maya: FYI: weekly release train bulletin — small heads-up items for this week's cadence.

- Canary windows: shifted to 09:30-11:30 local for better overlap with EMEA SREs.
- No major infra rollouts this week; focus on runtime perf and batching improvements.
- Freeze window: none scheduled, but we will enforce a soft quiet period during last 2 hours of Friday sprint close.

frank: Any risky changes landing this week?

maya: Noted risks: batching refactor (don) -> high impact on tail latency; quant-plugin upgrade (elaine) -> perf improvements but needs A/B on memory. Were gating both behind canaries.

don: Ill coordinate canary timing and limit size to 5% traffic.

elaine: Quant plugin rollout in staging looks good; will only enable auto-quant during off-peak.

ci-bot: Reminder: all runtime PRs must include perf regression checklist and 2 perf-run results.

maya: Ops: ensure spike capacity reserved for potential fallout from batching changes.

ops-bot: Reserved +20% burst capacity in eu-west-1 for Friday 16:00-18:00.

don: Noted. Ill also add preflight checks to verify KV cache warm rates.

maya: Thanks. If anything high risk shows up, well flip to an official quiet mode. Otherwise, keep regular cadence.

maya: End of bulletin.
